title: Disaster restore proof
description: Objective: prove complete backup generations, two-slot recovery anchors, fresh incarnation/key epochs, orphan inventory, and quiesced recovery after media loss. Deliverable: CORE-S14 restore fixtures and evidence. NOT in scope: ordinary restart or optimistic orphan adoption. Hard dependencies: full store/artifact/effect inventory implementations. Owned paths: tests/fault/disaster-restore/** and backup tooling paths. Verification: pnpm test:fault.
definitionOfDone: Crash at every prepare/install/fsync/switch boundary exposes either old authority or one verified quiesced restore, never a mixture.
Repeated same-generation restore uses fresh incarnation/key epochs and all stale grants fail.
Missing inventory or artifact/key proof keeps recovery unavailable with UNKNOWN_TRUTH.
taskRails: Claims follow the benchmark permit-list; missing, partial, cross-basis, or unverifiable evidence is UNKNOWN, never PASS.
No confirmatory corpus is generated or viewed until the implementation commit is frozen exactly as specified.
GO_QUIESCE and GO_ACTIVATE are separate human decisions. Keep evidence exact, reproducible, and scoped to one source commit.
